problems.title: Menu calculator
problems.statement: The first line is t. Each of the next t lines has a, an operator (+ - * / or another character) and b. Print the result; print Error for division by zero (integer division) and Invalid for an unknown operator.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Operands stored in int, so the product of two large numbers overflows.

bugs.label: CPP_ASSIGN_VS_COMPARE
bugs.note: Wrote = instead of == when testing for zero divisor.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Subtraction operands swapped.

problems.title: Bank balance
problems.statement: Read the opening balance and n, then n transactions: D amount deposits, W amount withdraws. A withdrawal larger than the balance is rejected. Print the final balance and the number of rejected withdrawals.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop runs n+1 times, repeating the last transaction.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Withdrawing exactly the whole balance is rejected.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Balance kept in int, deposits push it past 2^31.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Stops reading transactions after the first rejected withdrawal.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Deposit replaces the balance instead of adding to it.

problems.title: Daily temperatures
problems.statement: Read n (1 to 1000) and n daily temperatures. Print the highest, the lowest, and the number of days with temperature from 20 to 30 inclusive.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: max and min never initialised before comparing.

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: Array of 20 but up to 1000 temperatures are read.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: || instead of && so every day counts as comfortable.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Max/min scan starts at index 2 and skips a[1].

problems.title: Shopping bill
problems.statement: Read n (at least 1), then n lines of unit price and quantity. The bill is the sum of price times quantity, with 10 percent (integer division) taken off if it is more than 5000. Print the bill and the cheapest unit price.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Price and quantity are int so p*q overflows before being added.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Discount applied at exactly 5000 although it needs more than 5000.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Discount formula rounds differently from total minus a tenth.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Loop starts at 1 and skips the first item.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Minimum price never initialised.

problems.title: Queue simulation
problems.statement: Read m commands: E x enqueues x, D dequeues and prints the front (or empty if the queue is empty), S prints the current size. At most 2000 enqueues.

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: Queue array far too small for the number of enqueues.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Empty test misses head == tail, so an empty queue is read.

bugs.label: CPP_ASSIGN_VS_COMPARE
bugs.note: Used = in the command test, so every command enqueues.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Size printed one too large.

problems.title: Balanced brackets
problems.statement: Read t, then t strings made of ( ) [ ] (length up to 1000). For each print YES if the brackets are balanced and correctly nested, otherwise NO.

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: Stack array of 10 characters but strings may open hundreds of brackets.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Forgot the case of unclosed opening brackets at the end.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: ok flag is declared outside the loop and never reset between strings.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Pops the wrong slot (post-decrement) and compares against an unset element.

problems.title: Bubble sort by hand
problems.statement: Read n (up to 1000) and n integers. Sort them in increasing order with bubble sort and print them on one line separated by spaces.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Inner loop goes one step too far and compares with a[n].

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: One bubble pass too few, so the smallest two can stay unsorted.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Comparison reversed, sorts in decreasing order.

problems.title: Prime test
problems.statement: Read t, then t integers (any int, including 0 and negatives). For each print prime or not prime.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Forgot that 1, 0 and negatives are not prime.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Stops before d*d == x so squares of primes are called prime.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: d*d overflows int for x near 2^31.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Returns true after testing only d = 2.

problems.title: Number pyramid
problems.statement: Read n from 0 to 9. Print n rows; row i has n-i leading spaces, then 1 up to i and back down to 1 (for example row 3 is 12321).

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Row loop uses < so the last row is missing.

bugs.label: CPP_WRONG_LOOP_DIR
bugs.note: Second half counts up instead of down.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Downward count starts at i so the peak digit is printed twice.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Prints the row number instead of the counter.

problems.title: Parity statistics
problems.statement: Read n then n integers (may be negative). Print the number of even values, the number of odd values, the sum of the even values, and how many values have exactly two digits (10 to 99).

bugs.label: CPP_ASSIGN_VS_COMPARE
bugs.note: Assignment in the parity test; condition is always false.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Negative odd numbers give remainder -1 and are never counted.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Sum of evens stored in int.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Bounds 10 and 99 wrongly excluded.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Streak counter is not reset after a loss.

bugs.label: CPP_ASSIGN_VS_COMPARE
bugs.note: Assigns b to a, so every round looks like a tie.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Wrong winning rule: paper beats rock, not scissors.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Skips the first round.

problems.title: GCD and LCM
problems.statement: Read t, then t pairs of non-negative ints (not both zero). For each pair print the gcd (computed recursively) and the lcm.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: gcd has no stopping case, ends in a % 0.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The lcm is computed in int before being stored in long long.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Used a*b as the lcm, forgetting to divide by the gcd.

problems.title: Collatz steps
problems.statement: Read t, then t positive integers. For each, print how many steps the Collatz process (halve if even, 3n+1 if odd) needs to reach 1, using recursion.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: Stopping case n == 0 is never reached, the recursion cycles 1,4,2,1 forever.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Parameter is int, so 3n+1 overflows for some starting values.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Forgot to count the halving step.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Base case returns 1, so every count is one too high.

problems.title: Reverse and look up
problems.statement: Read n (1 to 1000) and n integers. Print them in reverse order on one line, then the maximum. Then read q and q positions (1-based); for each print the element at that position, or invalid if the position is outside 1..n.

bugs.label: CPP_WRONG_LOOP_DIR
bugs.note: Prints the array forwards instead of from the end.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Maximum never given a starting value.

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: Index read from input is used without any check.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Position n is rejected because the upper bound is written < n.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Uses a[k] instead of a[k-1] for a 1-based position.
